items.title: The normalization is the coproduct of the normalizations of the reduced irreducible components
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma describes the normalization of a scheme with locally finitely many irreducible components as the coproduct of the normalizations of its reduced irreducible components (statement lines 14587-14594). The counted proof is short and complete: it reduces to a reduced base using that normalization is unaffected by passing to the reduction, observes that on a reduced scheme the coproduct of the components is integral and locally birational over the base, and concludes either by the local description of normalization through integral closures or by the universal property of normalization for such morphisms (proof lines 14596-14603). It is H2: the reduction and both routes to the conclusion are stated in the counted span, and the cited inputs are statements of the same chapter.
